about.title: About this trainer and FAQ
about.intro: A free study aid for the German citizenship test (Einbürgerungstest) and the test "Leben in Deutschland": the 300 general questions and the 160 questions of the 16 federal states. It is not affiliated with the Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (BAMF). The questions are based on the official catalogue, Stand {stand}.
about.bookletHeading: Where to find the official booklet
about.bookletPage: Official page at the BAMF (the source of the catalogue)
about.bookletDownload: Download the PDF from the BAMF
about.bookletCopy: Our identical copy of the PDF
faq.official.a1: No. This is an independent practice tool. The official source is the BAMF, and the real test is taken at an authorised test centre. The questions here are taken from the official catalogue so that you practise with the real ones.
faq.edition.q: Which edition of the catalogue are the questions from?
faq.edition.a1: The "Gesamtfragenkatalog" with Stand {stand}, as published on the [BAMF website](bamfPage). It has 300 questions for all of Germany and 160 questions for the federal states, 10 for each state. This trainer contains all 460.
faq.authentic.q: How can I check that a question is exactly as in the official booklet?
faq.authentic.a1: Press "Original" on any question. You see that question cut out of the official PDF, exactly as printed, with its page number. The text was not retyped for this view.
faq.authentic.a2: You can also open the whole booklet: [download it from the BAMF](bamfPdf) or open our [identical copy](copy). The copy has the same checksum as the BAMF download.
faq.answers.q: Where do the correct answers come from?
faq.answers.a1: The official booklet lists the questions and answer options but does not mark the right answers. The answers here were worked out question by question from the laws and facts the questions ask about, and then checked a second time independently. Some answers depend on current law and can change. If you think an answer is wrong, please report it.
faq.translations.a1: No. The test is in German only. The English text is an unofficial aid, translated for this trainer. Rely on the German text.
faq.exam.q: What does the exam mode do?
faq.exam.a1: It mirrors the real test: 33 questions (30 general and 3 from the chosen federal state) drawn at random, 60 minutes, and 17 correct answers to pass. You get no feedback until you finish.
faq.privacy.q: What happens to my progress and my data?
faq.privacy.a1: Your progress, language and settings are stored only in your own browser, on your device. There is no account and nothing is sent to us. The page loads nothing from other servers: fonts and pictures are served from the same site. "Reset progress" erases your progress, and so does clearing your browser data. The details are in the [privacy notice](privacy), in German and English.
faq.changes.q: What if the official catalogue changes?
faq.changes.a1: The BAMF updates the catalogue from time to time, for example when a government changes. Questions about the current Chancellor, the head of state, the largest parliamentary groups, the number of EU members or the population are the most likely to change.
faq.changes.a2: If you notice a new edition or a changed question, please tell us with "Report a problem" and choose "The catalogue has changed". Check the [BAMF page](bamfPage) for the latest edition.
faq.report.q: I found a mistake. How do I report it?
faq.report.a1: Open "Original" on the question and press "Report a problem", or use "Report a problem" at the bottom of the page. You can open a prefilled GitHub issue or send an email. Either is fine.
faq.license.q: May I use or share this?
faq.license.a1: The code is free for personal and other noncommercial use under the [PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0](license). Commercial use is not allowed. The questions belong to the BAMF, the pictures and photo credits belong to their owners. See the [project page](repo) for details.
